patterns.note: Minimalist, spacious layout with ample white space, particularly in the main content area, emphasizing product imagery and brand messaging.
Consistent use of uppercase for navigation and sub-headings, paired with a distinctive serif logo, creating an elegant and authoritative typographic hierarchy.
A high-contrast palette of white backgrounds, black text, and a signature Cartier red used for subtle accents and the footer background.
The hero image background (sketched castle and sun) exhibits a subtle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground elements (watch, ring, 'FATHER'S DAY GIFTING' text) as the user scrolls down.
The primary navigation bar (Cartier logo, main menu items) becomes sticky and remains at the top of the viewport after scrolling past the initial hero section.
Additional descriptive text ('With a world of gifts...') is revealed below the main hero text with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as the user scrolls further into the hero section.
A full-width hero section with a large, illustrative image and prominent text, followed by a sparse content area before a detailed, multi-column footer.

technique_notes: The site employs a smooth scrolling experience, likely powered by `locomotive-scroll`, enhancing the perceived fluidity of page navigation.
The hero section features a multi-layered parallax effect, where the illustrative background scrolls at a slower rate than the product imagery and primary text, creating a dynamic sense of depth.
As the user scrolls, additional descriptive text related to the hero message is revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation, drawing attention to key messaging.

design_tokens.type_scale: Elegant serif logo and large, bold sans-serif headings contrast with smaller, refined sans-serif body text and uppercase navigation, conveying luxury and clarity.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp for most elements, with subtle rounding for input fields and buttons, maintaining a sophisticated and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical and horizontal padding, creating a sense of luxury and allowing elements to breathe, particularly in the hero and footer sections.

standout: The distinctive hand-drawn, illustrative hero imagery, combined with the brand's iconic products, creates a unique blend of whimsical artistry and high-end luxury. This approach elevates the brand experience beyond typical product photography, making it feel more personal and artistic.
